Guerber Park splash pad operates with limited capacity due to drainage issue
B. P. Huynh
The Guerber Park splash pad is currently operating at limited capacity due to a drainage problem that could cause flooding and damage to the playground if the water overflows, according to a July 8 announcement from the City of Eagle.
City officials said they are working to resolve the issue and thanked residents for their patience. The Merrill Park splash pad remains open and is running at full capacity, offering an alternative for families looking for recreational water activities.
Guerber Park is located at 2200 Hill Rd in Eagle, while Merrill Park can be found at 637 E Shore Dr in Eagle. Both parks feature splash pads designed for community use during the summer months.
According to the City of Eagle, its splash pads are open daily from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. until Labor Day.
The city has not provided a timeline for when repairs will be completed, but encourages visitors to use Merrill Park's facilities in the meantime.
